title: The simplest hypothesis extends the consciousness of brains to all matter

statements.text: The one thing known about the categorical nature of matter is that some of it, in brains, involves consciousness. The simplest and most parsimonious hypothesis is that matter outside brains is continuous with it. On this argument the existence of consciousness supports panpsychism as light-speed measurements support special relativity, without entailing it.

sources.quote: The most simple, elegant, parsimonious hypothesis is that the concrete categorical nature of the stuff outside of brains is continuous with that of brains in also being consciousness-involving.
The evident existence of consciousness supports the truth of panpsychism in much the same way that measurements of light support special relativity.
